Inside was a tightly rolled note, its paper yellowed but dry. “If you can read this,” it said, “tell my sister the garden still blooms.” There was no name, only a small drawing of a red cottage and a crooked tree. Elias recognized the place from an old chart: a tiny island beyond the northern reef, abandoned decades ago. He lit the beacon, then packed bread, a compass, and the note. She read it, smiled, and began to cry.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有完全醒来。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，偶尔有几盏灯亮着，像夜色里迟迟不肯熄灭的星星。街道空旷，路灯把微黄的光铺在湿润的地面上。清洁工推着车慢慢经过，远处传来第一班公交车低沉的声响。便利店门口，一位店员整理刚送来的货物；早餐铺的蒸笼已经冒出白汽，香气悄悄散进清冷的空气。风从街口吹来，树叶轻轻摇动。此时的城市安静而温柔，仿佛还藏着许多没有说出口的梦。再过一会儿，天边泛白，人群便会匆匆涌上街头。","w03":"- A recipe can use itself as a smaller recipe, repeating the same steps.\n- Each time, it handles a smaller piece of the problem until it reaches a simple stopping point.\n- Then the answers come back up the chain, like stacking blocks and taking them apart."}
